title: County Kicks Off Week of Action to Promote Workers’ Rights and Support Local Businesses
description:
The County of San Diego has launched its fourth annual Week of Action, bringing together community partners, advocates and local leaders to support workers and promote fair labor practices. The Office of Labor Standards and Enforcement (OLSE) shared updates on wage theft enforcement, partnerships with the District Attorney’s Office and the California Labor Commissioner, and the real‑life impact these efforts have had on workers.

If you or someone you know has questions about workplace rights or wage theft, contact OLSE at olse@sdcounty.ca.gov or 619‑531‑5129.
